description: Header file defining the ThermalController class for managing thermal states, temperature thresholds, and related features in a device. It includes configuration constants, class declarations, and method signatures for thermal management.

classes.name: ThermalController
classes.description: Class responsible for monitoring and managing device thermal states, including temperature thresholds, reboot and deep sleep logic, and declocking based on thermal conditions.

classes.name: ThermalController::INotification
classes.description: Interface for receiving thermal state change notifications and deep sleep triggers from ThermalController.

methods.description: Factory method to instantiate ThermalController with optional implementation and arguments.

methods.description: Retrieves current thermal level and temperature.

methods.name: GetTemperatureThresholds
methods.description: Gets high and critical temperature thresholds.

methods.name: SetTemperatureThresholds
methods.description: Sets high and critical temperature thresholds.
